description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Pairs created first-then-second: LE(k primary key, 4 rows, keys 4, 1, 3, 2) then LF(k indexed, 3 rows, keys 2, 1, 3); LG(no index, 4 rows, keys 4, 1, 3, 2) then LH(no index, 3 rows, keys 2, 1, 3); EE(k primary key, 3 rows, keys 3, 1, 2) then EF(k primary key, 3 rows, keys 2, 3, 1); EG then EH, the same keys, no index. Payloads t 'a1'... and u 'b1'... in insertion order. For each pair: SELECT t, u FROM first INNER JOIN second ON first.k = second.k, and listed the other way. Asks whether the smaller or the first-created table drives when both or neither side is indexed, and what decides a tie.
